mapper.select: SELECT b.NAME_, b.residential_address residentialAddress, b.birthdate, b.identify_type identifyType, b.identify_number identifyNumber, b.pid, b.active_time activeTime, b.invalid_time invalidTime, r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement, r.rel_predicate as predicate, r.pledge_ratio as pledgeRatio, r.shareholding_ratio as shareholdingRatio, r.equity_share asequityShare FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PSN' AND r.to_type = 'PSN' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid} Order BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC

SELECT b.`name_`, b.residential_address residentialAddress, b.birthdate, b.identify_type identifyType, b.identify_number identifyNumber, b.pid,r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PSN' AND r.to_type = 'PSN' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND b.DELFLAG_='1' AND r.rel_status='00' AND r.from_pid = #{pid} Order BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC

SELECT b.`name`, b.residential_address residentialAddress, b.birthdate, b.identify_type identifyType, b.identify_number identifyNumber, b.pid,r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PSN' AND r.to_type = 'PRO' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid} Order BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC

SELECT b.`name`, b.residential_address residentialAddress, b.birthdate, b.identify_type identifyType, b.identify_number identifyNumber, b.pid,r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PRO' AND r.to_type = 'PSN' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND b.DELFLAG_='1' AND r.rel_status='00' AND r.from_pid = #{pid} Order BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC
mapper.update: update bus_rel_psn set is_Iterate=#{isIterate} where pid=#{pid}

select glfbh from bus_rel_psn order by pid desc limit 1;

bus_rel_psn rel
bus_rel_org rel
LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item item ON rel.identify_type = item.ITEM_VALUE_ WHERE
rel.identify_number = #{relNumber} AND item.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-IdentifyType'

select psn.PID as pid ,psn.NAME_ as fromName ,rel.TO_PID as topid ,rel.FROM_PID as fromPid,rel.PID as relId ,rel.shareholding_strand as holdings,rel.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel as rel left join bus_rel_psn as psn on psn.PID = rel.FROM_PID where rel.TO_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1';

select psn.PID as pid ,psn.NAME_ as fromName ,rel.TO_PID as topid ,rel.FROM_PID as fromPid,relPro.PID as relId ,relPro.HOLDINGS as holdings,relPro.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel as relPro left join bus_rel_psn as psn on psn.PID = relPro.FROM_PID where relPro.TO_PID = #{pid} and relPro.DELFLAG_= '1';

select psn.PID as pid ,psn.NAME_ as fromName ,rel.TO_PID as topid ,rel.FROM_PID as fromPid,rel.PID as relId ,rel.HOLDINGS as holdings,rel.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_psn psn on rel.to_pid = psn.PID where rel.FROM_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1'

select psn.PID as pid ,psn.NAME_ as fromName ,relPro.FROM_PID as fromPid ,relPro.TO_PID as toPid , relPro.PID as relId ,relPro.HOLDINGS as holdings,relPro.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub left join bus_rel_psn psn on psn.PID = relPro.TO_PID where relPro.FROM_PID = #{pid} and relPro.DELFLAG_= '1'

select rel.pid relId, rel.to_pid toPid, rel.from_pid fromPid, r.NAME_ fromName, rel.shareholding_strand holdings, -- rel.relation_type relCategory, item1.ITEM_LABEL_ relCategoryLabel, rel.rel_psn_org relCategory, item2.ITEM_LABEL_ email, rel.FROM_TYPE from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_psn r on rel.from_pid = r.pid left join sys_dict_item item1 on rel.relation_type = item1.ITEM_VALUE_ and item1.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelationType' left join sys_dict_item item2 on rel.rel_psn_org = item2.ITEM_VALUE_ and item2.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelZZD' where rel.to_pid = #{pid} and rel.FROM_TYPE = 'PSN' and rel.approval_status = '6' and rel.DELFLAG_= '1'
union all

from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_org r on rel.from_pid = r.pid left join sys_dict_item item1 on rel.relation_type = item1.ITEM_VALUE_ and item1.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelationType' left join sys_dict_item item2 on rel.rel_psn_org = item2.ITEM_VALUE_ and item2.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelZZD' where rel.to_pid = #{pid} and rel.FROM_TYPE = 'ORG' and rel.approval_status = '6'and rel.DELFLAG_= '1'

select rel.pid relId, rel.to_pid toPid, rel.from_pid fromPid, r.NAME_ fromName, rel.shareholding_strand holdings, -- rel.relation_type relCategory, item1.ITEM_LABEL_ relCategoryLabel, rel.rel_psn_org relCategory, item2.ITEM_LABEL_ email, rel.FROM_TYPE, rel.TO_TYPE from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_psn r on rel.TO_PID = r.pid left join sys_dict_item item1 on rel.relation_type = item1.ITEM_VALUE_ and item1.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelationType' left join sys_dict_item item2 on rel.rel_psn_org = item2.ITEM_VALUE_ and item2.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelZZD' where rel.FROM_PID = #{pid} and rel.TO_TYPE = 'PSN' and rel.approval_status = '6' and rel.DELFLAG_= '1'
union all
select rel.pid relId, rel.to_pid toPid, rel.from_pid fromPid, r.ORG_NAME fromName, rel.shareholding_strand holdings, -- rel.relation_type relCategory, item1.ITEM_LABEL_ relCategoryLabel, rel.rel_psn_org relCategory, item2.ITEM_LABEL_ email, rel.FROM_TYPE, rel.TO_TYPE
from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_org r on rel.TO_PID = r.pid left join sys_dict_item item1 on rel.relation_type = item1.ITEM_VALUE_ and item1.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelationType' left join sys_dict_item item2 on rel.rel_psn_org = item2.ITEM_VALUE_ and item2.DICT_CODE_ = 'BUS-RelZZD' where rel.FROM_PID = #{pid} and rel.TO_TYPE = 'ORG' and rel.approval_status = '6' and rel.DELFLAG_= '1'
